name: New Zealand
dossier:
The New Zealand national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the All Whites, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 85 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from OFC to this expanded 48-team tournament.

The ultimate Cinderella, dreaming of a first-ever World Cup win.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, New Zealand will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group G and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group G. The connection between Chris Wood and Marko Stamenić is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Chris Wood - the clinical striker who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: New Zealand are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: New Zealand are the only team to leave the 2010 World Cup unbeaten  -  three draws, then knocked out.
New Zealand boast 0 World Cup titles in their historical cabinet, with their best tournament finish being Unbeaten group stage (2010).
